item.title: Wireless Broadband Alliance offers guidance on AI and ML
item.description: The Wireless Broadband Alliance (WBA) has issued a new report that outlines how AI and machine learning are becoming 'foundational' to Wi-Fi and enabling autonomous, self-optimizing networks. #pressrelease

item.title: Orange puts trust at heart of new strategic plan
item.description: Orange today presented its new Trust the Future strategic plan for the next three years to 2028 that focuses on innovation and efficiency.

item.title: London calling: EE 5G standalone user review
item.description: The UK operator has built a high-quality 5G SA network that is consistent, reliable and, at its best, is 'snappy' and eminently useable.

item.title: Reliance and Adani commit $210B to make India an AI-infra hub
item.description: Reliance and Adani to invest a combined $210 billion to position India as a sovereign, cost-competitive infrastructure hub for hyperscale compute growth.

item.title: 5G SA is expanding, but outcomes are uneven and challenges remain – report
item.description: A new report from Ookla and Omdia tracks the current status of 5G standalone deployments and highlights that while regional coverage gaps are narrowing, a profound 'capability gap' has widened.

item.title: The Buildout: ImOn adds thousands to Iowa fiber footprint
item.description: This week in broadband builds: ImOn completes fiber expansion in Clinton and Camanche, Iowa; Astound starts construction in Nisqually, Washington; NKTelco grows Flight Fiber footprint in Ohio; Spectrum lights up Texas – and more.

item.title: Eurobites: TIM turns to Microsoft for sovereign cloud assist
item.description: Also in today's EMEA regional roundup: Microsoft, OpenAI sign up for UK's AI security push; DT, Samsung combine on mobile identity platform; Telia cuts jobs in Finland.

item.title: Comcast touts low-latency advantage with 'RealTime4K'
item.description: Comcast said its streaming of Super Bowl LX in 'RealTime4K' delivered the game about 17 seconds behind the live action, on par with over-the-air broadcasts and better than several virtual MVPDs.

item.title: The 'new' Harmonic prepares to cut the video cord
item.description: Harmonic is set to become a 'pure-play broadband leader' amid the sale of its video business to MediaKind. With a focus on FTTP and DOCSIS, Harmonic also aims to diversify its business well beyond Comcast and Charter.

item.title: Carr urges broadcasters to air 'patriotic, pro-America programming' to support US milestone
item.description: FCC Chairman Brendan Carr's Pledge America Campaign calls on broadcasters to run pro-America programming in support of US's 250th. Such programming could include patriotic PSAs and short segments highlighting US history and civic education, and starting each broadcast day with the Star Spangled Banner or Pledge of Allegiance. #pressrelease
